title.zh: 开源权重AI模型逼近前沿，安全差距依然存在
title.en: Open-weight AI models are catching up to the frontier. The safety gap remains.

summary.zh: 一项新报告指出，Z.ai的开源模型GLM-5.2在能力上已接近前沿AI水平，但缺乏关键的安全缓解措施。这再次引发了对强大开源模型可能超越治理和安全发展的担忧。
summary.en: A new report finds Z.ai's open-weight GLM-5.2 model approaches frontier AI capabilities but lacks key safety mitigations. This reignites concerns that powerful open models could outpace governance and safety development.

title.zh: Anthropic与AI云初创公司Volta签署100亿美元协议
title.en: Anthropic signs $10B deal with AI cloud startup Volta

summary.zh: Anthropic近几个月持续进行云合作伙伴关系扩张，最新举措是与AI云初创公司Volta达成一项价值100亿美元的协议。此举凸显了AI模型公司对大规模计算基础设施的巨量需求。
summary.en: Anthropic continues its cloud partnership spree with a reported $10 billion deal with AI cloud startup Volta. This highlights the massive demand for compute infrastructure from AI model companies.

title.zh: Nvidia领导的开放AI安全联盟成立一周即显进展
title.en: Nvidia’s open AI industry group already showing progress after one week

summary.zh: 由Nvidia牵头、已发展到超过120家公司的“开放安全AI联盟”成立仅一周，就已提出了防御AI代理的方案。这显示了行业对协同应对AI安全威胁的迫切需求和快速行动力。
summary.en: The week-old Open Secure AI Alliance, led by Nvidia and now over 120 companies, has already released proposals for defending against AI agents. This shows the industry's urgent need and rapid action to collaboratively address AI security threats.

title.zh: SpaceX营收因Anthropic和谷歌算力协议及星链增长而翻倍
title.en: SpaceX doubles revenue on Anthropic and Google compute deals, Starlink growth

summary.zh: 根据其上市后首份季度财报，SpaceX的营收比去年同期翻了一番。增长主要得益于向其他AI公司（如Anthropic和谷歌）提供计算服务的协议以及星链业务的持续增长。
summary.en: According to its first quarterly earnings since going public, SpaceX's revenue doubled compared to last year. The growth was driven by deals providing compute to other AI companies like Anthropic and Google, and continued Starlink expansion.

title.zh: AMD数据中心业务因AI需求激增而蓬勃发展，游戏业务退居次席
title.en: AMD’s data center business is booming while gaming takes a backseat

summary.zh: 受AI计算能力需求的推动，AMD最新财报显示其数据中心收入同比翻倍有余，达到67亿美元。游戏业务收入则出现下滑，反映出公司战略重心向AI和数据中心市场的转移。
summary.en: Driven by demand for AI capacity, AMD's data center revenue more than doubled year-over-year in its latest earnings report, reaching $6.7 billion. Gaming revenue saw a decline, reflecting the company's strategic shift towards AI and data center markets.

title.zh: 需求过于庞大，德州暂停数据中心接入电网
title.en: Texas halts data center connections to power grid amid overwhelming demand

summary.zh: 曾将德州标榜为AI“中心”的州长，因需求过大而暂停了数据中心并入电网的申请。这一举措凸显了AI基础设施（特别是大型数据中心）的快速发展对能源供应系统构成的巨大压力。
summary.en: The governor who touted Texas as an AI 'epicenter' has paused data center grid connections due to overwhelming demand. This move highlights the significant pressure that the rapid growth of AI infrastructure, particularly large data centers, is placing on power supply systems.

title.zh: 美国公司AI技术让乌克兰廉价自杀式无人机实现自主追踪
title.en: US company’s AI lets Ukraine’s cheap kamikaze drones track targets on their own

summary.zh: 一项价值1亿美元的交易将为5万架乌克兰无人机配备美国开发的AI能力，使其能够自主追踪目标。这标志着AI在现代战争，特别是无人机集群攻击中的应用正变得越来越实际和关键。
summary.en: A $100 million deal will equip 50,000 Ukrainian drones with US-developed AI capabilities for autonomous target tracking. This signifies the increasingly practical and critical role of AI in modern warfare, particularly for drone swarm attacks.

title.zh: OpenAI称苹果的商业秘密诉讼“攻击性强且异常私人化”
title.en: OpenAI says Apple's trade secrets lawsuit is 'aggressive and oddly personal'

summary.zh: OpenAI回应苹果的诉讼，称其“攻击性强且异常私人化”，并声明“我们没有、也不想要他们的任何商业秘密”。这起诉讼反映了顶尖AI公司与大型科技平台之间因人才和知识产权问题日益紧张的竞争关系。
summary.en: OpenAI responds to Apple's lawsuit, calling it 'aggressive and oddly personal' and stating 'We do not have, nor want, any of their trade secrets.' This lawsuit reflects the increasingly tense competition between top AI firms and major tech platforms over talent and intellectual property.

title.zh: 安卓应用开发者可能在不知情下与广告商共享用户位置数据
title.en: Android app developers may be unwittingly sharing their users’ location data with advertisers

summary.zh: 电子前沿基金会（EFF）的新发现警告应用开发者，他们集成的某些第三方代码可能在用户授权后，也会收集用户的位置数据并共享给广告商。这凸显了移动开发中第三方SDK带来的隐私和数据安全风险。
summary.en: New findings by the Electronic Frontier Foundation warn app developers that some third-party code they integrate may collect their users' location data when granted permission, and share it with advertisers. This highlights privacy and data security risks posed by third-party SDKs in mobile development.

title.zh: 我们如何在六个月内构建实时响应式语音AI系统
title.en: How we built a realtime system for responsive voice AI in six months

summary.zh: GPT-Live实现了与AI的连续语音交互，采用无轮次（turnless）语音模型和低延迟架构，以实现更快速、更自然的对话。这展示了构建大规模、低延迟实时AI语音交互系统的技术路径和挑战。
summary.en: GPT-Live enables continuous voice interaction with AI, using a turnless speech model and low-latency architecture for faster, more natural conversations. This demonstrates the technical path and challenges for building large-scale, low-latency real-time AI voice interaction systems.
